_README: Seed dataset. This file IS the product — the planner can only be as good as this.
1. Do not add a place whose opening_hours you have not read from an official
source (rng.org.il, the site's own page, the local authority).
Never fill hours from memory and never let a model guess them.
2. opening_hours: [open, close] in 24h, or null if closed that weekday.
3. duration_min: realistic visit length, not the minimum possible.
4. region is hand-assigned. test_regions.py smoke-tests it against latitude.
6. All internal fields English. Only *_he fields are Hebrew.
TARGET: 10 per region tonight, ~30 per region eventually.
